reason: The query is slow due to multiple correlated subqueries that execute separately for each user, leading to inefficient performance as the number of users increases.
fix:
SELECT u.display_name, 
             COUNT(p.id) as post_count, 
             AVG(p.score) as avg_score, 
             SUM(p.view_count) as total_views 
      FROM users u 
      LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.owner_user_id = u.id 
      WHERE u.reputation > $1 
      GROUP BY u.id 
      ORDER BY avg_score DESC;
